## Summary

Describe the user-visible or architectural change and why it belongs in Captain’s Log.

## Verification

- [ ] `tools/verify-all.sh` passes.
- [ ] New behavior has focused tests.
- [ ] Documentation and release notes are updated when behavior changes.
- [ ] No recording, transcript, database, log, credential, device identifier, personal path, or
      generated package is included.
- [ ] Source/transport/OS details remain in leaf adapters and MVVM boundaries remain intact.
- [ ] I have read and agree to the applicable Individual or Entity CLA linked from
      `CONTRIBUTING.md`; if submitting for an entity, I am authorised to bind it.
- [ ] I own the submitted material, or any approved third-party material is identified with its
      exact source and licence.

## Hardware evidence

List the exact device/OS combinations exercised, or write “not hardware tested.” Do not include
Bluetooth identifiers or private data.
